text:
maya: Hey team — I opened a docs PR to add a sample dataset + dashboard snippet for quota/tier metering. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234

sam: Nice. Can you include a tiny ingestion example (curl or python) so customers can reproduce the Grafana panels locally? :eyes:

maya: Yep. Plan is a small python generator and a curl example to POST usage points. Also callout the units (tokens vs requests) — that's bitten people before.

jordan: Quick nit on the tiers table in the PR diff: the "unit" column is ambiguous. Can we rename to "billing_unit (tokens)" or add a note?

maya: Good catch — I'll update the column name and add an explanatory footnote. Also added a sample command in the PR description: 

```bash
# generate synthetic usage for demo tenant
python tools/gen_usage.py --start 2026-03-16 --days 7 --tenant demo
```

pat: Can we also include an SDK snippet that shows the meter header shape? People copy/paste the wrong header and hit backfills. Something like: 

```http
POST /v1/usage HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.inference
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Meter: tenant=demo;units=tokens;amount=1234
Content-Type: application/json

{ "timestamp": "2026-03-16T12:00:00Z", "route": "/v1/generate", "tokens": 1234 }
```

sam: Love it. Also add a short section explaining burst credits and how they show up in the dashboard (so customers don't think their quota disappeared).

lisa: I can review later today. FYI include the exact Grafana dashboard import JSON link in the PR so reviewers can import and verify panels quickly: https://grafana.example.com/d/abcdef/quota-dashboard

docs-bot: build preview for PR #1234 started.

maya: One more snippet request — show the PromQL used for the rate-limit panel so teams can tweak thresholds: 

```promql
sum(rate(redwood_rate_limiter_credits_total{tenant="demo"}[5m]))
```

maya: Also added a short note on how "tokens" map to billing tiers (example: 1 request with 512 tokens billed as 512 tokens).

sam: :thumbsup: This should cut down on support tickets. Make sure the README has the migration note for older SDK versions that used a different header format.

docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/ (checks: linkcheck, lint)

pat: Approved and merged the PR — will backfill a short entry into the migration guide about header changes and burst-credit semantics.

maya: Thanks! I'll open a follow-up PR to add localized copies for the sample snippets (fr, de) and to include a tiny CSV download for the demo dataset.

lisa: Thanks all, will sanity-check the panel titles once the preview is up.

docs-bot: PR #1234 merged by pat. Release note: "quota docs: sample dataset + dashboard snippets"
